name: Shade sail
placement: Over a patio or lawn lounge; the corners hang from three posts, so check with the venue about footings.
modeling: An equilateral triangle (4.88 m sides) as one thin tilted fabric plane, its corners at about 3.0, 2.7 and 2.4 m, and three thin metal posts under the corners. Shade type: slats (open flat cloth, eave 2.4).
